name: Pog.pet
one_liner: A personalized physical pet product that makes the customer’s pet come alive on their phone and becomes a persistent Pog actor.
core_thesis: Personalized pet gifting has existing emotional demand on Etsy. A stronger product combines the physical artifact with a portable 3D/AR pet actor. The initial purchase can become the acquisition event for a persistent digital identity that later participates in Pogtown, games, clips and messages.
why_now: Personalized pet goods already sell; browser 3D/AR and generative asset pipelines can make the output dramatically more experiential.
job: Turn my pet into a memorable personalized physical + animated digital gift.
distribution: Etsy first, short listing videos, then pog.pet direct.
moat: Reusable pet-actor pipeline and persistent identity/world integration rather than one-off video generation.
falsifiers: AR adds no willingness to pay over simpler pet videos.
Asset generation/rigging cannot be automated cheaply enough.
Etsy listing distribution is insufficient to acquire buyers.
